original.statement: A bug where HTTPS in slow request scenarios (e.g. high packet loss networks) could cause an Envoy memory leak was fixed.

decision.reason: [ev-c0fcac29e341] describes a bug fix: Envoy could leak memory when HTTPS was used in slow-request scenarios such as networks with high packet loss. That is a runtime change in how HTTPS is handled, with no configuration or value change, so protocol-behavior with behavior-changed fits. The name https-slow-request-envoy-memory-leak uses only key words from the evidence and is unambiguous.
